name: Juukan ACE NO.07-2
source:
Main character dog Hayate enjoys a sweet cohabitation with his human girl lover, but she gets kidnapped by a mysterious secret society led by dog "Rakshasa". Protagonist is outmatched in this fight, so he goes to a hidden priest village to gain power and recover his love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角狗狗疾风与他的人类女友享受着甜蜜的同居生活，却被狗狗“罗刹”领导的神秘秘密社团绑架。主角在这场战斗中处于劣势，因此他前往隐藏的牧师村庄以获得力量并恢复他的爱情。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
